text: I'm a childminder, I've got a 9 year old boy here tonight while his parents are away and I think he just had a fit?? Not sure, I've never seen one before. He went all stiff and then his arms and legs were jerking, and his eyes went up so you could only see the whites. Maybe a minute or two, I didn't time it, sorry. His mum says he's never had one before. Now he's really hard to wake, I have to shake him and say his name loads and he just mumbles and goes floppy again. It's not like him at all, he's normally chatty even when he's tired. Temp is 37.9. His neck seems ok I think, when I got him to look down at his tummy he could do it fine. I've rung his mum but can't get through. Please tell me what to do I'm really scared
